correctness.rationale: Two exact exhaustive independent face enumerations agree for every integer stage d=0..4, covering all 262144 subsets of K2×K3×K3. Fully verified acyclic face matchings, exact signed integer Morse boundaries and unit Smith reductions give the five torsion-free homology groups. The first checker independently lifts all degree8/9 source generators to full signed cycles and tests total simplicial boundaries equal zero, maps those cycles to target critical chains, and establishes all inclusion ranks using nonzero maximal minors modulo two primes. The target Smith matrices have only unit pivots, making these rational rank deductions rigorous. The separate reversed-order implementation computes integral Smith normal forms using a different induced-forest test; full f-vectors and Betti data agree. The result deliberately makes no homotopy wedge or integral barcode claim.

value.rationale: Question 44 of arXiv:2307.13271 asks for positive-degree forest filtrations of triple categorical products. The m=n=3 product is the first symmetric unsolved parameter after the known K2×K2×Kn family. Complete finite integral homology and rational persistence explain a motivated mixed-dimensional threshold (17 degree7, 36 degree8 and 6 degree9 at d2) and exhibit 6 top-dimensional homology classes surviving the entire later filtration. These exact natural invariants are not implied by the previously known independence complex, and they reveal behavior relevant to the broader open question without claiming a general solution.
